text.content:
NetWatch joins the world's city nets, over the old trunk lines.

When: 2048–2060; the first certified trunks out of Night City opened in 2049
Where: The NET, worldwide
Who was involved: NetWatch; Night Corp, which took over the CitiNet in 2049
What it changed: One interconnected NET with a NetWatch gate at every junction; Agents banned; the Neuroport everywhere

After Static Night, NetWatch did what it had said for twenty-five years couldn't be done: it began linking the city nets together over the old trunk lines, with protection it had never had before. Within ten years most of the world's cities were joined into one interconnected NET.

In the same years NetWatch banned Agents and their VIs worldwide, as doors the RABIDs could walk through, and the phone in your pocket became the chrome in your head: by the late fifties the Neuroport was cheap, safe and everywhere. By the early sixties street quickhackers were reaching Neuroports from across the street, and the corps answered with Firewalls in every one.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.06
